site: Shiv Shakti Point — Chandrayaan-3 landing site
citation: NASA LRO LOLA polar GDR, south of 60 S, 60 m/px
grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear
resolution_note: source product is 60 m/px; this 512px grid at 4 m/px spans 34.1 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
note: Uneven mare-highland regolith; the traverse is over undulating regolith rather than a named grade.
